headline: FIFA World Cup 2026 — Round of 32 concludes
items: RESULT: Switzerland 2-0 Algeria — Embolo & Ndoye seal Switzerland's first World Cup knockout win in 88 years
RESULT: Spain 3-0 Austria — Oyarzabal brace either side of Pedro Porro's strike
RESULT: Portugal 2-1 Croatia — Goncalo Ramos' 94th-minute header wins it after Ronaldo's leveller
RESULT: Belgium 3-2 Senegal (AET) — Tielemans' 125th-minute penalty completes comeback from 2-0 down
RESULT: England 2-1 DR Congo — Harry Kane's brace sends England through
